She waves enthusiastically at the camera with her right hand while smiling broadly. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with warm indoor lighting, featuring orange-brown booths and TASTY brand logos on the walls. Graphical overlays resembling a live stream interface, including a LIVE tag and scrolling user comments in Traditional Chinese, are visible on the screen. (2) The camera angle remains in a selfie handheld style as the woman moves through the restaurant, gesturing toward her face and the surrounding environment. Her facial expressions are highly animated, involving frequent eye contact and mouth movements. The background shows blurred tables, chairs, and other diners in the distance. The lighting is consistent and bright, typical of a well-lit commercial space. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the woman sitting at a long table covered with a white cloth. The table is laden with numerous plated dishes, including steaks, salads, appetizers, and a glass of white wine. She holds a fork and knife in the air, expressing wide-eyed surprise and excitement. Colorful graphic elements like hand-drawn hearts and confetti patterns are superimposed on the frame. (4) Close-up shots show the woman taking large bites of steak, closing her eyes, and nodding to signify enjoyment. Large bold text in Traditional Chinese appears sequentially at the bottom of the frame, providing promotional details. The video concludes with a full-screen graphic card featuring the woman’s portrait, the brand logo, and a picture of a seafood platter with detailed promotional text and dates.
